svg.title: Relay Orchard: 3-day restoration system design
svg.desc: A one-page heavy design for Relay Orchard, a solo 3-day desktop game about repairing a radio observatory. Six linked subsystems show a spatial travel map, local rules with stable IDs, a normal 3-day win trace, an energy-shortage recovery trace, and open decisions.

g.text: What must the player track over 3 days to repair the receiver and install the relay before Day 3 ends?
Scope: full 3-day restoration; solo desktop; AP/energy/resource economy
R-01: 6 AP/day; an action needs its AP + resources to start
AP6 En3 Wtr2 Scr2; rest start 0.
Names next dawn: clear or storm.
Cuts combined dawn fruit yield by 1.
R-03: every leg costs 1 AP + 1 energy; bidirectional
No route connects Grove, Reservoir, or Observatory directly.
Player starts Day 1 at Workshop. Charger (subsystem 3) works at any node.
This map is the dominant model; each panel attaches to one of its 4 nodes.
Any location: 1 AP to gain 3 energy.
Dawn resets AP only, not energy.
Entailed by R-02; see both traces
No other trades exist at Workshop.
WIN if installed before Day 3 ends (R-13)
NORMAL TRACE / 3-DAY WIN (v2 rules; clear weather both dawns)
1. Dawn 1, Workshop: AP6 En3 Wtr2 Scr2; rest 0 (R-01, R-01b v2 energy).
2. To Observatory (R-03): AP5 En2. Repair (R-12): AP4 En2 Scr0.
3. Scan (R-11): AP3 En0 Res1. Charge (R-04, v2 +3): AP2 En3.
4. Scan again (R-11): AP1 En1 Res2. Player ends Day 1 with 1 AP unused.
5. Dawn 2 (no marker yet): AP6 En1 Wtr2 Scr0 Res2. To Grove (R-03): AP5 En0.
6. Tend (R-06a): AP4 Wtr1 +1 marker. Charge: AP3 En3. Tend again: AP2 Wtr0 +1 marker.
7. Player ends Day 2 with 2 AP unused and 2 markers pending; return is free.
8. Day 2's forecast said Dawn 3 clear; it arrives clear. 2 markers to 4 fruit (R-06b).
9. Start: AP6 En3 Frt4 Res2. Trade (R-09): AP5 Frt2 Cred3. Buy scrap (R-10): AP4 Scr1.
10. To Observatory: AP3 En2. Install (R-13): AP1 Res0 Scr0. WIN (AP1, En2 spare).
v1's Grove-first Day 1 no longer fits a scan under v2 energy (see verification.md, DT-02).
The required energy-shortage recovery resumes after the first Day-1 scan.
1. Day 1 at Observatory, after first scan: AP3 En0 Wtr2 Scr0 Frt0 Cred0 Res1.
2. Receiver repaired. Attempt second scan (1 AP + 2 energy): BLOCKED at En0.
3. State stays AP3 En0 Wtr2 Scr0 Frt0 Cred0 Res1 (R-01, R-15).
6. Rejoins normal trace after its second Day-1 scan; same Day-3 WIN.
R-15: blocked scan names 2 missing energy; charging restores the normal sequence.
Experience: feel resourceful and caring while restoring the orchard's observatory.
Win: install the relay before Day 3 ends (R-13). Loss: incomplete restoration (R-14).
Q-01 OPEN: weather schedule / random model is undecided (forecast itself is accurate).
Q-02 OPEN: story consequence of an incomplete-restoration outcome is undecided.
Q-03 OPEN: replay behavior after incomplete restoration is undecided.
Q-04 OPEN: saving progress between real-world play sessions is undecided.
DT-02: v1's exact Grove-first Day 1 cannot fit its first scan under v2.
PLAYTEST T-01 (test hypothesis, not a confirmed rule):
Can new players identify the missing energy and use the charger without help?
No combat, multiplayer, monetization, equipment leveling, or procedural map (C-02).
Open items stay open. This page does not silently resolve them as confirmed rules.
